native-jax-fp8-raw-microbatch-root-commi.message:
[levanter] Preserve FP8 state in raw microbatches

Raw microbatch accumulation averaged FP8 histories alongside ordinary
parameter gradients. With input maxima 32 and 1, this stored 16.5 instead
of the required maximum 32.

Reuse the shared custom-gradient reducer during accumulation and exclude
custom state from gradient averaging. Keep metric reductions and RNG
splitting unchanged. Add a real FP8 regression with independent NumPy
loss and weight-gradient references and explicit scale/history checks.

Part of https://github.com/marin-community/marin-logbooks/issues/4.
